title: Festival Day Pass Planner
description:
## Task

A festival lists events that each run over a range of whole days, `[first_day, last_day]` inclusive. A visitor can go to at most one event per day, and an event counts if the visitor attends it on any one of its days. Return the largest number of different events the visitor can attend. Days can be as large as 10^9, and there can be 10^5 events, so day-by-day simulation over the whole range or trying every assignment is too slow.

## Input

- `events` — a list of `[first_day, last_day]` pairs with `first_day ≤ last_day`, in any order. It may be empty.

## Output

The most events that can be attended (an integer).

## Example

```python
max_events_attended([[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]])  # returns 3
max_events_attended([[1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1]])  # returns 1
max_events_attended([[1, 3], [1, 3], [1, 3], [3, 4]])  # returns 4
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ number of events ≤ 10^5
- 1 ≤ `first_day` ≤ `last_day` ≤ 10^9
